title: Puzzle Pieces, Bi-accessibility, and Connectivity of the Julia Set for Generalized Blaschke Products
summary: We study the dynamics of a parametric family of rational functions of odd degree, where each function is a generalized Blaschke product that maps the unit circle onto itself. The action of the Blaschke product restricted to the unit circle defines a circle map, and the parameter space of the family exhibits Arnold tongues. As the parameter varies over an Arnold tongue, the action of the circle map changes from a diffeomorphism to a non-injective endomorphisms.
